title: Insurance Claim Repairs Cashier Standard — Amount of an Overpayment Refund
content:
## Clause

When the customer's payments and credits on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order exceed its customer charges and the refunds already made, the excess is refunded against one payment and goes back to that payment's method within the class's refund processing business days. The refund is that excess less the price of every signed customer-pay addition consent whose charge is not yet posted, returned against the most recent customer payment and never more than that payment, rounded to the cent.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Defined as |
|---|---|
| Paid side | the customer payments on the repair order, together with the credits on it |
| Owed side | the customer charges on the repair order, together with the refunds already made on it |
| Excess | the paid side less the owed side, never below zero |
| Signed additions not yet charged | the total price of the signed customer-pay addition consents on the repair order, less the customer-pay addition charges already posted on it (unrelated-damage charges and part-upgrade charges), never below zero |
| Refund | the excess less the signed additions not yet charged, never below zero, and never more than the most recent customer payment; rounded to the cent once, at the end |

The refund goes back to the method of the payment it returns. The refund processing time is the class's figure in the Insurance Claim Repairs payment terms.

## Worked refunds (hypothetical repair orders)

**Case 1.** Payments USD 1,500.00 (a card payment of USD 1,000.00, then a check of USD 500.00); no credits; charges USD 1,200.00; no earlier refund. Signed customer-pay addition consents total USD 250.00, of which USD 150.00 is already posted as a charge.
- Excess: USD 1,500.00 less USD 1,200.00, USD 300.00.
- Signed additions not yet charged: USD 250.00 less USD 150.00, USD 100.00.
- Refund: USD 300.00 less USD 100.00, USD 200.00 — within the most recent payment of USD 500.00 — returned against the check.

**Case 2.** Payments USD 900.00 (USD 780.00, then a final USD 120.00); charges USD 600.00; no signed customer-pay addition consents.
- Excess: USD 300.00.
- Refund: limited to the most recent payment, USD 120.00.

**Case 3.** Excess USD 80.00; signed additions not yet charged USD 130.00.
- Refund: USD 80.00 less USD 130.00 is below zero, so nothing is refunded.

## Basis Q&A

**Do credits count with payments?** Yes. Payments and credits together form the paid side.

**Do earlier refunds count?** Yes, on the owed side, with the charges: money already returned is not returned again.
